name: genesys-cloud-mcp
description: Read-only Genesys Cloud API tools for Claude Desktop.

genesyscloud_region.title: Genesys Cloud region
genesyscloud_region.description: Your Genesys Cloud hostname (for example, mypurecloud.com) or SDK region key.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID
oauth_client_id.description: The client ID of your Genesys Cloud OAuth client.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Optional. Leave blank to sign in through the browser using Authorization Code with PKCE.

persist_tokens.title: Remember browser sign-in
persist_tokens.description: Save browser access and refresh tokens in the OS credential store. Disable to keep them in memory only.
